comparison.objective: Install correct end and mid clamps at six solar-panel positions; unlike commissioning a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp selection, alignment, seating, and fastening. Any fastening primitive is generic; there is no adjustment from repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Each correct clamp type seated level at its proper position scores one sixth. Tightening torque and geometric tolerances are missing; no spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Tests component selection and multi-position panel clamping, not variable damping adjustment.
